title.narrative: Development of a Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Framework for the implementation of the St. Kitts and Nevis National Gender Equality Policy and Action Plan

description.narrative: The St. Kitts and Nevis National Gender Equality Policy and Action Plan is the government’s commitment to mainstream gender, and is a blueprint to achieve gender justice equality. Key to its implementation is the establishment of a comprehensive framework for monitoring, evaluating, reporting, documenting lessons, and updating its targets and priorities based on evidence of performance against indicators. The Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Framework (MELF) will feature a Gender Statistics Database to analyze sex-disaggregated data and promote gender indicators and related performance measurement necessary for guiding gender-aware policy-making, planning, programming, and service delivery in the Federation. The Framework would provide an opportunity for the Federation to conduct detailed analysis of pressing issues such as gender socialization, the marginalization of boys in mainstream education, the causes of violence such as early exit from education (drop-out rates between the sexes with special focus on males).
